content.short: Sentio is an end-to-end observability platform for smart contracts, enabling developers to monitor, alert, and debug on-chain code on Mantle.
content.description: Sentio is a comprehensive smart contract observability platform providing developers with real-time event streaming, custom dashboards, alert systems, and deep transaction tracing for their deployed contracts. Supporting Mantle Network, Sentio allows protocol teams to maintain operational visibility into smart contract behavior with minimal infrastructure overhead  bringing DevOps-style monitoring practices to on-chain development.
content.meta: Sentio is a smart contract observability and monitoring platform for protocols deployed on Mantle. Discover Sentio on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
